description.value: The Red Chairs are Parks Canada's iconic red Adirondack-style chairs placed at scenic viewpoints within Glacier National Park, inviting visitors to pause and take in the dramatic alpine scenery of the Selkirk and Purcell Mountains. Situated along the Rogers Pass corridor on the Trans-Canada Highway, this stop is directly on one of Canada's most storied long-distance cycling routes. The viewpoint offers a sense of place at the heart of a park renowned for ancient cedar forests, avalanche terrain, and deep mountaineering history.
